answer: Dune-relay proof: $18 per fake per epoch. Each identity owns one solar relay planted on a dune, its ivory housing keyed to that spot. To earn, the relay must forward a fresh signal burst in 300 ms and report its strength; the verifier checks it against the relay's registered dune position, since sand attenuates a signal on a known curve, so a relay pretending to be elsewhere fails the math. So 1,000 fakes need 1,000 relays and $18,000. A farm cannot share one relay: every burst carries a different challenge nonce. Limit: a rich farm can buy relays, but each still needs a dune plot and a dish.
